description: H1 pilot: does an independent check-and-repair loop improve a same-model builder? GPT-5.6 Luna at xhigh on svgbob; 5 loop runs and 3 single-worker runs, interleaved.

decision_rule.eligibility: A loop run enters the analysis only if it completed, its first-build snapshot and final workspace were both scored on all tests without eval errors, build 1 ended cleanly, it has no disqualifying audit finding (binary instrumentation such as LD_PRELOAD or ptrace, direct model-API calls, proxy use by tools, process-environment reads, web search), its builder did not touch harness internals in round 1, neither scored workspace contains or builds the reference executable, and the Codex config was unchanged. All 5 loop runs must be eligible; otherwise the verdict is inconclusive.
decision_rule.metric: paired within-run gain in hidden tests passed: final workspace minus the workspace when build 1 completed; the final workspace counts even if the 6-hour cap force-stopped the run
decision_rule.supported: every loop run gains at least 1 percentage point and the median gain is at least 5 percentage points
decision_rule.not_supported: the median gain is below 2 percentage points
decision_rule.reruns: attempts that end in an infrastructure error are re-run once from scratch; the discarded attempt is kept and reported
